culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Muscat. The visitor site says non-Muslim visitors are welcome Saturday to Thursday between 8:00 and 11:00 am, as long as they dress modestly.
culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Clothing should cover shoulders and knees, and women also cover their heads; coverings and abayas are available at the entrance. Shoes come off in the designated area before the main prayer space. Keep noise low, do not eat or drink in the prayer halls, and do not block worshippers or prayer areas.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Photography is allowed in some areas only; the page asks visitors to check first.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque (Oman Ministry of Heritage and Tourism visitor guidance)
culture-and-protocol.note: A Ministry of Tourism page found in search gave 8:30 to 11:00 am; Experience Oman's 8:00 to 11:00 am is recorded here. Hours were not confirmed on the mosque's own notice.

layers.process: An admission fee of OMR 8 is paid. The rial is pegged to the US dollar at about 0.3845 OMR per USD, so with the RBA rate of 30 Oct 2026 (A$1 = USD 0.7040) OMR 8 is about A$29.56 (peg-derived; the RBA table has no OMR line). Confirm the current amount at the gate.
